book.name: Abosel
book.title: Abosel Yesuse okok dlasanin nakai i weng sangobe.

content: Fole siib tem monea Lom bib onsebe.

Festase baanea Fole Itali betano Lom bib uneko ge baasea i Fol esa eka klabut nakai mak isa dleb moniba klabuti kimanin nakae Yuliase dlansiobe. Awa genalin nakai komok ele Lom teni komok sume e awa genalin naka etabe.

Luk ne tena bia i tenanoba Sisalia bib ye bioba siib make Adlamitiam bib danea tlanea Esia betan unang ge kesoa ni bib olo deibonoba siib ele tem unom genaboba Masedonia nakae niniino Alistakase Tesalonaika bib danea tetemea etem nanoba beboba kwinoa aala bioba siibe dleb bebea
bomanoa monoba Saidon bib ye unanoba Yuliase Fole weng ayam baabanea Kobo moneba keb nekwali yateneba inamin namino dokliba dleb tlang gaeb osa ayamobo ge baabasea Fole inanea mo danea imin tle ole
Saidon bibo deibonoba Itali betan unemin deib unom genaboba glol sume tleme kesoa ye deibo deibonoba aaubile Saiblase abuk sin da ota glole mensa omkabe kesoa ye deib monoba
Silisia betano tle tle Famfilia betano tle tleo omtla nanoba monoba Lisia betano bibo niniino Maila bib wat sobnoma bomasoa
Yuliase temea siibe make Aleksandlia bib danea tlanea Itali betan unang genabe kesoa atenea dletnea watnoba siib ele tem wat unanoba

fiab beteng beboba am homono blimanoa monoba Naidas bibo kikib ye beboba glole tlebianea deibo walea ni deibo onamino tobtlin halob kesoa deibonoba aaubile Klit da ota glole mensa kesoa ye tem te monoba Salmoni bibo omtlanoba
ken tla bebianoba bumolok wat wat binoba watnoba Lasia bibo kikib wato aaye ulam omfanea tlamanebio wat unanoba aay ele niniino Ulam Ayam etabe.
Ye bioba am homono blimanabua Yudai hengmin omketouyemin amo blimanole glol sume tlebianea aaye mousie haa tlebiamnea siibe unang gameo watwat danamabe kesoa Fole baabenea
Naka ibo ne wengo wentine! Ne bobol temo fumbio aay ele deibanoba unob mole siib esa afobeing osa naka nibsa misiam nanomabbio kesoa nibo ele biomo ge funaiobo ge baabene otane
awa genalin nakai kimanin nakae Fole wengo mo wentim blimobe. E siibe kimanin naka esa eka siib gosak esa i weng ota wentenea

eka naka homoni siib tem ye tana blib ile baaniba Glol sume tlemang gabea nibo aa dang ele biob yole ayambabo, aa dang olo deibonoba monoba Finiks bib ye bioba tlebinea blimanseta unomo ge baasiobe. Finiks bibo aaubile Klite tem biotabe. Bib olo glol sume mo tlebinabebabe. O glol blim bib ayamobe.
Glol sume tlebianea aaye mousie haa tlemonsebe.

I inangge baanabiba glole Saut dae gwabsa tleme kesoa i funaniba Glol ele mensa kesoa aamun sume ayam unomabbiobo ge funaniba siibe skilo deisoniba daaknoa tamanobuo imin wafueiba utloa aamun ele deibanoba aaubile Klit da eta kikibanoba ken tla ye beboba
glole sume niniino Taleo e Klit da tlebianea
siibe onamin deibo waisanea fuba obetnea monoba
aaubil gwabe e niniino Kodae mukam deib bebianoba aaye mousie sumo mo haa tlemin blim bie kesoa weseme gwabe siibe abuk da tab obgieibbue melekla binoba obginoba buba

obeb utnoba siibe dame dim ut obasa genoba i funaniba Glole siibe fuba obeb monea Afelika betano ninin aalim wat delabbanemebo geniba siibe glole fuba obeb haanin youme gamtlabaniba siibe fiab beteng obki bebianea
obubma obabma bebea bomanoa i funaniba Siibe misiam anamabebo geniba i afobeingo mako dibiaiba daaknoa aan tem daak unoa deibonoba beboba
bomanoa i siibe glole fuba obeb haanin youmo mak osa eka sai osa eka inamin namin afet osa imin dibiaiba aan tem daak blela kiki unoa deibonoba beboba

am homono blimanso soko tlebianoa ayungo neketowa genoa abil ete dabal ete nanea kaki binea ni afok osa awitnin osa mo watemin blimobe. Eka imen osa mo doweim blim nabioba glol sume sma ye tlebea ni bobol temo fumbianoba Siibe misiam anea obeb daak unomabbiobo ge fumboba Fole nakai isak daak hana manea baabenea Ibo ne wengo wentutneiba Klit aaubil ye biobta mole inamin namin misiamo mo tam tlobabe.
Eka ne weng mako baabenamabi ole Siibe misiam anamabe otane naka nib ole elekieme mo kaanomabbiobabe. Nibo alukum sma biomabbiobe. Ibo bobol ayam fumbibte!
Ne God Sume niniino dobtouleb binabibua sintalo kwinoa Gode abisake tenea baatnenea
Fol kobo mo tosianemebe! I kemetniba Lom teni komok sum esu unamabeobo, Gode kla gobke bie kesoa keb bekeb isa mo kaanomabibbabo ge baatnenesobe.
Ibo bobol ayam funine! Gode wengo baatneneo bain inanamabebe. Ne Gode weng olo baatneneo bainobo geiobe.
Aaye sma dleb monea aaubile make ken ye dlanamabebo ge baabesebe.
Siibe misiam ansebe.

Ni inam beboba amo 14 o bliman ole 14 olo kwinota glole siibe fuba obetnea aaye sole niniino Edliae dang tla beboba ibalanoa afoko tenoa isak ewit tloa siibe okok kemin nakai funaniba ken ele tlobbu ese makobo geniba
aamune saye ki temiba 36 mita yeb minim kesoa deiba bebianiba eka imin ki temiba 27 mita yeb minim kene kesoa
i funaniba Siibe tom dimo wambianemeo helanamabebo ge funaniba siibe skilo asuke asuke nao kakam sino olaiba daaknoa bikisoa funaniba Amo hebmamsab bomanoko ge funaniba

siibe okok kemin nakai funaniba Siibe deibanoba weseme gwabe tem unomo geniba i weseme oboniba aalang daak ofakaniba maki dim baabeniba Ni metnoba siibe gabam met unanoba siibe skilo mako olanob daaknoa bikinamabobo ge baabesiba
Fole i bobol tem funino tekein kenea awa genalin naka isa eka i komok esa baabenea Naka eli siibe deiba unib mole ibo yalowa kulilanomabiobo ge baabesea
awa genalin nakai weseme saye waisaiba obkileb unea
amo bomanang genamo kesoa Fole nakai alukum baabenea Amo 14 o blimano dimo ibo bobol misiam fumbianiba imen osa mo doweim blim tebib kesoa
ibo memalo imeno dowoniba sbal maine! Inamin namin misiamo nib dimo mo tam tlubenomobabo ge baabenea
e imeno olonea Gode heitdabanea hanea unansea naka maki atemniba
i bobol ayam funaniba imi osa olo dowonsiobe.
Nakai siib ele tem tame bisobi homoni 276 obe.
Ni inanoba imeno dowonoba matwayensoa siibe abil alobiebo geniba asiamo niniino wito dibiaiba aantem daak blela kiki unoa deibonaboba

afoko tubunoa i ninin alimo watemib otane i betan olo mo tekein kebibbabe. I inaniba wateme bianiba temiba aaye ulomfanea aamune dikilanea ninine obbia utlebio kesoa ateniba i funaniba Nibo siibe obeb utnoba ninin alim ut unomo geniba

i siibe skilo sayo weisoiba oleb daak unoa siibe stiae afu obeb haanin ase tileisaniba eka siibe glole fuba obeb haanin youme doboniba gabam dae imin dobbuniba glole fuba obeb watnea ninine kikib wat une otane
aaye isak wate daal omfanebua siibe watnea delab banea aaye mousie haa tlebianea siibe kakam dae helane kesoa
awa genalin nakai funaniba Klabuti skilaniba aaye wa onon tlanimiobo yenanomo gesiba
komoke funanea I Fole mo ananimibe ge funane kesoa awa genalin nakai watanea e nakai alukum baabenea Aawamin naka ibo wa moniba ken unine!
Eka aawaminba kweifum ibole siibe klutanea hanota olakaniba wafu blibta dleb monoa ken danoko ge baabesea ni alukum inanoba watnoba ken was onon tlasobobe.
